    X = clean_X(df_syn[FEATURES].values)
    y_depth = df_syn["depth"].values

    skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=SEED)

    group_accs = cross_val_score(
        RandomForestClassifier(**RF_PARAMS), X, groups, cv=skf, scoring="accuracy"
    )

        X_d, g_d = X[mask], groups[mask]
        if len(np.unique(g_d)) < 2:
            continue
        skf_d = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=SEED)
        try:
            accs = cross_val_score(
                RandomForestClassifier(**RF_PARAMS), X_d, g_d, cv=skf_d, scoring="accuracy"
            )
            per_depth_group_accs[str(d)] = float(np.mean(accs))
        except ValueError:
            per_depth_group_accs[str(d)] = None

    return {
        "cell": cell_name,
        "depth_pred_acc": float(np.mean(depth_accs)),
        "depth_pred_std": float(np.std(depth_accs)),
        "seed_group_pred_acc": float(np.mean(group_accs)),
        "seed_group_pred_std": float(np.std(group_accs)),
        "chance_seed_group": 1.0 / N_SEED_GROUPS,
        "per_depth_seed_group_pred": per_depth_group_accs,
    }


def main(sub_experiments=None):
    if sub_experiments is None:
        sub_experiments = ["A", "B", "C"]
    results = {"subexp_a": [], "subexp_b": [], "subexp_c": []}
    t0 = time.time()

    for cell_name, rel_path in CELLS.items():
        fpath = ROOT / rel_path
        if not fpath.exists():
            print(f"SKIP {cell_name}: {fpath} not found")
            continue
        print(f"\n{'='*60}")
        print(f"Processing {cell_name}")
        print(f"{'='*60}")

        df = load_features(rel_path)
        print(f"  Loaded {len(df)} rows, depths: {sorted(df['depth'].unique())}")

        if "A" in sub_experiments:
            print("  [A] d1-d3 3-class classification...")
            res_a = subexp_a(df, cell_name)
            results["subexp_a"].append(res_a)
            print(f"      acc={res_a['d1d3_acc_mean']:.4f} +/- {res_a['d1d3_acc_std']:.4f}")

        if "B" in sub_experiments:
            print("  [B] Seed-stratified LOGO...")
            res_b = subexp_b(df, cell_name)
            results["subexp_b"].append(res_b)
            print(f"      LOGO acc={res_b['logo_acc_mean']:.4f} +/- {res_b['logo_acc_std']:.4f} (range {res_b['logo_acc_min']:.4f}-{res_b['logo_acc_max']:.4f})")

        if "C" in sub_experiments:
            print("  [C] Negative control (seed group vs depth)...")
            res_c = subexp_c(df, cell_name)
            results["subexp_c"].append(res_c)
            print(f"      depth_pred={res_c['depth_pred_acc']:.4f}, seed_group_pred={res_c['seed_group_pred_acc']:.4f} (chance={res_c['chance_seed_group']:.2f})")

    elapsed = time.time() - t0
    results["elapsed_seconds"] = elapsed

    print(f"\n{'='*60}")
    print("SUMMARY")
    print(f"{'='*60}")

    if "A" in sub_experiments and results["subexp_a"]:
        print("\n[A] d1-d3 3-class accuracy (chance=33.3%):")
        for r in results["subexp_a"]:
            print(f"  {r['cell']:25s}  {r['d1d3_acc_mean']*100:5.1f}% +/- {r['d1d3_acc_std']*100:4.1f}%")
        a_accs = [r["d1d3_acc_mean"] for r in results["subexp_a"]]
        print(f"  {'MEAN':25s}  {np.mean(a_accs)*100:5.1f}%")
    
    if "B" in sub_experiments and results["subexp_b"]:
        print("\n[B] Seed-stratified LOGO accuracy (d1-d3):")
        for r in results["subexp_b"]:
            print(f"  {r['cell']:25s}  {r['logo_acc_mean']*100:5.1f}% +/- {r['logo_acc_std']*100:4.1f}%  (range {r['logo_acc_min']*100:.1f}-{r['logo_acc_max']*100:.1f}%)")
        b_accs = [r["logo_acc_mean"] for r in results["subexp_b"]]
        print(f"  {'MEAN':25s}  {np.mean(b_accs)*100:5.1f}%")
    
    if "C" in sub_experiments and results["subexp_c"]:
        print("\n[C] Negative control -- depth vs seed group prediction:")
        print(f"  {'Cell':25s}  {'Depth':>8s}  {'SeedGrp':>8s}  {'Chance':>8s}  {'Ratio':>8s}")
        for r in results["subexp_c"]:
            ratio = r["depth_pred_acc"] / max(r["seed_group_pred_acc"], 0.01)
            print(f"  {r['cell']:25s}  {r['depth_pred_acc']*100:7.1f}%  {r['seed_group_pred_acc']*100:7.1f}%  {r['chance_seed_group']*100:7.1f}%  {ratio:7.1f}x")
    
    print(f"\nTotal elapsed: {elapsed:.1f}s")

    out_path = OUT_DIR / "w2_domain_bias_results.json"

{"success": true, "data": {"stdout": """"W2 Domain Bias Validation — three sub-experiments to demonstrate
depth signal is not a domain artifact from Wikipedia seed text.

Sub-exp A: d1-d3 only 3-class RF (all 9 cells)
Sub-exp B: Seed-stratified LOGO 10-fold on d1-d3
Sub-exp C: Negative control — predict seed group vs depth from features
"""

import json
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from pathlib import Path
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold, cross_val_score
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, classification_report
import time

ROOT = Path("/root/autodl-tmp/recursive_gen_depth_est")
OUT_DIR = ROOT / "results" / "w2_domain_bias"
OUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

FEATURES = [
    "mean_ppl", "var_ppl", "skewness_ppl", "kurtosis_ppl",
    "p10_ppl", "p25_ppl", "p50_ppl", "p75_ppl", "p90_ppl",
    "mean_surprisal", "var_surprisal", "entropy_of_surprisal",
    "type_token_ratio", "hapax_ratio", "bigram_entropy", "trigram_entropy",
    "rep_2gram", "rep_3gram", "rep_4gram",
]

CELLS = {
    "pythia_nucleus095": "data/features_all.jsonl",
    "pythia_temp09": "data/pythia_temp09/features.jsonl",
    "pythia_topk50": "results/pythia_topk50/features.jsonl",
    "gpt2xl_nucleus095": "data/gpt2xl/features.jsonl",
    "gpt2xl_temp09": "results/gpt2xl_temp09/features.jsonl",
    "gpt2xl_topk50": "results/gpt2xl_topk50/features.jsonl",
    "olmo_nucleus095": "data/olmo/features.jsonl",
    "olmo_temp09": "results/olmo_temp09/features.jsonl",
    "olmo_topk50": "results/olmo_topk50/features.jsonl",
}

RF_PARAMS = dict(n_estimators=200, random_state=42, n_jobs=-1)
N_SEED_GROUPS = 10
SEED = 42


def load_features(rel_path):
    rows = []
    with open(ROOT / rel_path) as f:
        for line in f:
            if line.strip():
                rows.append(json.loads(line))
    df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    return df


def clean_X(X):
    X = np.array(X, dtype=np.float64)
    bad = np.isinf(X) | np.isnan(X) | (np.abs(X) > 1e15)
    if bad.any():
        X[bad] = np.nan
        for col in range(X.shape[1]):
            mask = np.isnan(X[:, col])
            if mask.any():
                finite = X[~mask, col]
                X[mask, col] = np.median(finite) if len(finite) > 0 else 0.0
    X = np.clip(X, -1e15, 1e15)
    return X


def get_seed_ids(df_syn):
    """Per-depth sequential assignment.
    Each depth numbered 0..N-1 independently, making groups depth-balanced.
    """
    seed_ids = np.zeros(len(df_syn), dtype=int)
    for d in sorted(df_syn["depth"].unique()):
        mask = (df_syn["depth"] == d).values
        seed_ids[mask] = np.arange(mask.sum())
    return seed_ids


def assign_groups(seed_ids):
    unique_seeds = np.sort(np.unique(seed_ids))
    n_seeds = len(unique_seeds)
    group_size = max(1, n_seeds // N_SEED_GROUPS)
    seed_to_group = {}
    for i, sid in enumerate(unique_seeds):
        seed_to_group[sid] = min(i // group_size, N_SEED_GROUPS - 1)
    return np.array([seed_to_group[s] for s in seed_ids]), n_seeds


# -- Sub-exp A: d1-d3 only 3-class classification --

def subexp_a(df, cell_name):
    df_syn = df[df["depth"].isin([1, 2, 3])].reset_index(drop=True)
    X = clean_X(df_syn[FEATURES].values)
    y = df_syn["depth"].values

    skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=SEED)
    fold_accs = []
    for train_idx, test_idx in skf.split(X, y):
        rf = RandomForestClassifier(**RF_PARAMS)
        rf.fit(X[train_idx], y[train_idx])
        fold_accs.append(accuracy_score(y[test_idx], rf.predict(X[test_idx])))

    rf_full = RandomForestClassifier(**RF_PARAMS)
    rf_full.fit(X, y)
    report = classification_report(y, rf_full.predict(X), output_dict=True)

    return {
        "cell": cell_name,
        "d1d3_acc_mean": float(np.mean(fold_accs)),
        "d1d3_acc_std": float(np.std(fold_accs)),
        "d1d3_n_samples": len(df_syn),
        "chance_3class": 1/3,
        "per_class_recall": {
            str(k): round(v["recall"], 4) for k, v in report.items() if k in ["1", "2", "3"]
        },
    }


# -- Sub-exp B: Seed-stratified LOGO on d1-d3 --

def subexp_b(df, cell_name):
    df_syn = df[df["depth"].isin([1, 2, 3])].reset_index(drop=True)
    seed_ids = get_seed_ids(df_syn)
    groups, n_seeds = assign_groups(seed_ids)

    X = clean_X(df_syn[FEATURES].values)
    y = df_syn["depth"].values

    fold_accs = []
    for g in range(N_SEED_GROUPS):
        test_mask = groups == g
        train_mask = ~test_mask
        if test_mask.sum() == 0 or train_mask.sum() == 0:
            continue
        rf = RandomForestClassifier(**RF_PARAMS)
        rf.fit(X[train_mask], y[train_mask])
        fold_accs.append(accuracy_score(y[test_mask], rf.predict(X[test_mask])))

    return {
        "cell": cell_name,
        "logo_acc_mean": float(np.mean(fold_accs)),
        "logo_acc_std": float(np.std(fold_accs)),
        "logo_acc_min": float(np.min(fold_accs)),
        "logo_acc_max": float(np.max(fold_accs)),
        "n_folds": len(fold_accs),
        "n_seeds": n_seeds,
    }


# -- Sub-exp C: Negative control — seed group vs depth prediction --

def subexp_c(df, cell_name):
    df_syn = df[df["depth"].isin([1, 2, 3])].reset_index(drop=True)
    seed_ids = get_seed_ids(df_syn)
    groups, _ = assign_groups(seed_ids)

    X = clean_X(df_syn[FEATURES].values)
    y_depth = df_syn["depth"].values

    skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=SEED)

    depth_accs = cross_val_score(
        RandomForestClassifier(**RF_PARAMS), X, y_depth, cv=skf, scoring="accuracy"
    )

    group_accs = cross_val_score(
        RandomForestClassifier(**RF_PARAMS), X, groups, cv=skf, scoring="accuracy"

Now the key question: does the row ordering in the features files match the seed_id ordering in the raw data?

The features file for each cell has:
- Depth 0: sample_id 0-4999
- Depth 1: sample_id 5000-9999
- etc.

The raw data files have seed_id that goes 0, 1, 2, ..., 4999 sequentially.

The feature extraction code presumably reads the raw data files in order and writes features in the same order, so:


- features row with sample_id 5000 (depth 1, position 0 within depth) → seed_id 0
- features row with sample_id 5001 (depth 1, position 1 within depth) → seed_id 1
- etc.

So `get_seed_ids()` which assigns np.arange(5000) within each depth should be correct since the ordering is preserved. OK, so within each depth, the raw data is ordered sequentially by seed_id (0, 1, 2, ..., 4999). The features file also has samples in the same order (sample_id 5000, 5001, ... for depth 1 matches seed_id 0, 1, 2, ...).

So `get_seed_ids()` with `np.arange(mask.sum())` does correctly produce seed IDs 0-4999 for each depth.

But wait, the task says there's a bug. Let me re-read the problem statement more carefully:


The issue is that Sub-B (Leave-One-Group-Out) uses global sample_id (0-19999) for grouping, which maps groups to depth rather than to individual seed articles — that's what's causing the 8pp drop and 22.9% minimum performance degradation. Looking back at `get_seed_ids()`, it creates sequential IDs 0-4999, but these aren't actually matching the global sample IDs that the grouping function expects.

The real problem is the assumption that row 0 across all depth files refers to the same seed article. Since there are 5000 Wikipedia seed articles that flow through the entire generation pipeline — each seed generates depth-0 (original text), then depth-1 (model-generated), depth-2, etc. — and the features preserve this ordering by seed_id, the grouping should work correctly if the indices align. But the global sample_id assignment is breaking that alignment. I'm comparing the LOGO results across different cells to see if there's actually a performance drop. Looking at pythia_nucleus095, the LOGO accuracy matches the standard cross-validation results almost exactly, which suggests the seed-article grouping might already be working correctly. Let me check if there's a meaningful difference between the LOGO and standard CV approaches by examining the results across multiple models.

{"success": true, "data": {"stdout": "# Leave-one-group-out feature ablation across 9 cells.
# For each cell, removes one feature group at a time and measures accuracy drop.
# RF params match existing pipeline: n_estimators=200, random_state=42, 5-fold stratified CV.

import json
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from pathlib import Path
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold

ROOT = Path("/root/autodl-tmp/recursive_gen_depth_est")
OUT_DIR = ROOT / "results" / "feature_ablation"
OUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

FEATURES = [
    "mean_ppl", "var_ppl", "skewness_ppl", "kurtosis_ppl",
    "p10_ppl", "p25_ppl", "p50_ppl", "p75_ppl", "p90_ppl",
    "mean_surprisal", "var_surprisal", "entropy_of_surprisal",
    "type_token_ratio", "hapax_ratio", "bigram_entropy", "trigram_entropy",
    "rep_2gram", "rep_3gram", "rep_4gram",
]

CELLS = {
    "pythia_nucleus095": "data/features_all.jsonl",
    "pythia_temp09": "data/pythia_temp09/features.jsonl",
    "pythia_topk50": "results/pythia_topk50/features.jsonl",
    "gpt2xl_nucleus095": "data/gpt2xl/features.jsonl",
    "gpt2xl_temp09": "results/gpt2xl_temp09/features.jsonl",
    "gpt2xl_topk50": "results/gpt2xl_topk50/features.jsonl",
    "olmo_nucleus095": "data/olmo/features.jsonl",
    "olmo_temp09": "results/olmo_temp09/features.jsonl",
    "olmo_topk50": "results/olmo_topk50/features.jsonl",
}

GROUPS = {
    "perplexity": ["mean_ppl", "var_ppl", "skewness_ppl", "kurtosis_ppl",
                   "p10_ppl", "p25_ppl", "p50_ppl", "p75_ppl", "p90_ppl"],
    "surprisal": ["mean_surprisal", "var_surprisal", "entropy_of_surprisal"],
    "lexical_diversity": ["type_token_ratio", "hapax_ratio"],
    "ngram_entropy": ["bigram_entropy", "trigram_entropy"],
    "repetition": ["rep_2gram", "rep_3gram", "rep_4gram"],
}

RF_PARAMS = dict(n_estimators=200, random_state=42, n_jobs=-1)
SKF = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)


def load_cell(rel_path):
    rows = []
    with open(ROOT / rel_path) as f:
        for line in f:
            if line.strip():
                rows.append(json.loads(line))
    df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    X = df[FEATURES].values.astype(np.float64)
    X = np.nan_to_num(X, nan=0.0, posinf=1e15, neginf=-1e15)
    X = np.clip(X, -1e15, 1e15)
    y = df["depth"].values
    return X, y


def cv_accuracy(X, y, feature_indices=None):
    if feature_indices is not None:
        X_sub = X[:, feature_indices]
    else:
        X_sub = X
    if X_sub.shape[1] == 0:
        return 0.0, 0.0
    accs = []
    for train_idx, test_idx in SKF.split(X_sub, y):
        rf = RandomForestClassifier(**RF_PARAMS)
        rf.fit(X_sub[train_idx], y[train_idx])
        accs.append(rf.score(X_sub[test_idx], y[test_idx]))
    return float(np.mean(accs)), float(np.std(accs))


def main():
    results = {}

    for cell_name, rel_path in CELLS.items():
        print(f"Processing {cell_name}...", flush=True)
        X, y = load_cell(rel_path)

        full_acc, full_std = cv_accuracy(X, y)
        cell_result = {
            "full_19": {"acc_mean": round(full_acc, 6), "acc_std": round(full_std, 6)},
        }

        for group_name, group_features in GROUPS.items():
            group_indices = [FEATURES.index(f) for f in group_features]
            remaining_indices = [i for i in range(len(FEATURES)) if i not in group_indices]
            remaining_features = [FEATURES[i] for i in remaining_indices]

            acc_without, std_without = cv_accuracy(X, y, remaining_indices)
            delta = acc_without - full_acc

            cell_result[group_name] = {
                "acc_without": round(acc_without, 6),
                "acc_std": round(std_without, 6),
                "delta_vs_full": round(delta, 6),
                "features_removed": group_features,
                "n_features_removed": len(group_features),
                "features_remaining": remaining_features,
                "n_features_remaining": len(remaining_features),
            }
            sign = "+" if delta >= 0 else ""
            print(f"  -{group_name} ({len(group_features)}f): {acc_without:.4f} ({sign}{delta:.4f})", flush=True)

        results[cell_name] = cell_result

    # Cross-cell summary
    summary = {"per_group": {}}
    for group_name in GROUPS:
        deltas = [results[c][group_name]["delta_vs_full"] for c in CELLS]
        accs = [results[c][group_name]["acc_without"] for c in CELLS]
        summary["per_group"][group_name] = {
            "mean_delta": round(float(np.mean(deltas)), 6),
            "std_delta": round(float(np.std(deltas)), 6),
            "min_delta": round(float(np.min(deltas)), 6),
            "max_delta": round(float(np.max(deltas)), 6),
            "mean_acc_without": round(float(np.mean(accs)), 6),
            "n_features": len(GROUPS[group_name]),
        }

    ranked = sorted(summary["per_group"].items(), key=lambda x: x[1]["mean_delta"])
    summary["most_impactful_group"] = ranked[0][0]
    summary["least_impactful_group"] = ranked[-1][0]
    summary["ranking_by_impact"] = [
        {"group": g, "mean_delta": d["mean_delta"], "n_features": d["n_features"]}
        for g, d in ranked
    ]
    results["summary"] = summary

    full_accs = [results[c]["full_19"]["acc_mean"] for c in CELLS]
    results["summary"]["full_19_mean_acc"] = round(float(np.mean(full_accs)), 6)

    print(f"\n--- Summary (mean delta across 9 cells) ---")
    for item in summary["ranking_by_impact"]:
        sign = "+" if item["mean_delta"] >= 0 else ""
        print(f"  {item['group']:20s}: {sign}{item['mean_delta']:.4f} ({item['n_features']}f removed)")
    print(f"  Most impactful: {summary['most_impactful_group']}")

    out_path = OUT_DIR / "leave_one_group_out.json"
    with open(out_path, "w") as f:
        json.dump(results, f, indent=2)
    print(f"\nSaved {out_path}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""W2 Domain Bias Validation v2 — uses actual seed_id from raw data.

Fix: replaces get_seed_ids() sequential-ordering assumption with
explicit seed_id read from depth_*.jsonl raw data files.

Sub-exp A: d1-d3 only 3-class RF (5-fold stratified CV, all 9 cells)
Sub-exp B: Seed-stratified LOGO 10-fold on d1-d3 (actual seed article groups)
Sub-exp C: Negative control — predict seed group vs depth from features
"""

import json
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from pathlib import Path
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold, cross_val_score
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, classification_report
import time

ROOT = Path("/root/autodl-tmp/recursive_gen_depth_est")
OUT_DIR = ROOT / "results" / "w2_domain_bias"
OUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

FEATURES = [
    "mean_ppl", "var_ppl", "skewness_ppl", "kurtosis_ppl",
    "p10_ppl", "p25_ppl", "p50_ppl", "p75_ppl", "p90_ppl",
    "mean_surprisal", "var_surprisal", "entropy_of_surprisal",
    "type_token_ratio", "hapax_ratio", "bigram_entropy", "trigram_entropy",
    "rep_2gram", "rep_3gram", "rep_4gram",
]

CELLS = {
    "pythia_nucleus095": {"features": "data/features_all.jsonl", "raw_dir": "data"},
    "pythia_temp09": {"features": "data/pythia_temp09/features.jsonl", "raw_dir": "data/pythia_temp09"},
    "pythia_topk50": {"features": "results/pythia_topk50/features.jsonl", "raw_dir": "data/pythia_topk50"},
    "gpt2xl_nucleus095": {"features": "data/gpt2xl/features.jsonl", "raw_dir": "data/gpt2xl"},
    "gpt2xl_temp09": {"features": "results/gpt2xl_temp09/features.jsonl", "raw_dir": "data/gpt2xl_temp09"},
    "gpt2xl_topk50": {"features": "results/gpt2xl_topk50/features.jsonl", "raw_dir": "data/gpt2xl_topk50"},
    "olmo_nucleus095": {"features": "data/olmo/features.jsonl", "raw_dir": "data/olmo"},
    "olmo_temp09": {"features": "results/olmo_temp09/features.jsonl", "raw_dir": "data/olmo_temp09"},
    "olmo_topk50": {"features": "results/olmo_topk50/features.jsonl", "raw_dir": "data/olmo_topk50"},
}

RF_PARAMS = dict(n_estimators=200, random_state=42, n_jobs=-1)
N_SEED_GROUPS = 10
SEED = 42


def load_features(rel_path):
    rows = []
    with open(ROOT / rel_path) as f:
        for line in f:
            if line.strip():
                rows.append(json.loads(line))
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


def load_seed_ids_for_depth(raw_dir, depth):
    path = ROOT / raw_dir / f"depth_{depth}.jsonl"
    seed_ids = []
    with open(path) as f:
        for line in f:
            if line.strip():
                row = json.loads(line)
                seed_ids.append(row["seed_id"])
    return seed_ids


def load_features_with_seed_id(feat_path, raw_dir):
    df = load_features(feat_path)
    seed_id_col = np.zeros(len(df), dtype=int)

    for d in sorted(df["depth"].unique()):
        raw_seeds = load_seed_ids_for_depth(raw_dir, d)
        d_mask = (df["depth"] == d).values
        d_count = d_mask.sum()
        assert len(raw_seeds) == d_count, (
            f"Count mismatch depth {d}: raw={len(raw_seeds)}, features={d_count}"
        )
        seed_id_col[d_mask] = raw_seeds

    df["seed_id"] = seed_id_col

    # Sanity check: each depth should have the same set of seed_ids
    for d in sorted(df["depth"].unique()):
        d_seeds = set(df.loc[df["depth"] == d, "seed_id"])
        assert len(d_seeds) == (df["depth"] == d).sum(), (
            f"Duplicate seed_ids in depth {d}"
        )

    return df


def clean_X(X):
    X = np.array(X, dtype=np.float64)
    bad = np.isinf(X) | np.isnan(X) | (np.abs(X) > 1e15)
    if bad.any():
        X[bad] = np.nan
        for col in range(X.shape[1]):
            mask = np.isnan(X[:, col])
            if mask.any():
                finite = X[~mask, col]
                X[mask, col] = np.median(finite) if len(finite) > 0 else 0.0
    X = np.clip(X, -1e15, 1e15)
    return X


def assign_groups(seed_ids, n_groups=N_SEED_GROUPS):
    unique_seeds = np.sort(np.unique(seed_ids))
    n_seeds = len(unique_seeds)
    group_size = max(1, n_seeds // n_groups)
    seed_to_group = {}
    for i, sid in enumerate(unique_seeds):
        seed_to_group[sid] = min(i // group_size, n_groups - 1)
    return np.array([seed_to_group[s] for s in seed_ids]), n_seeds


# -- Sub-exp A: d1-d3 only 3-class classification --

def subexp_a(df, cell_name):
    df_syn = df[df["depth"].isin([1, 2, 3])].reset_index(drop=True)
    X = clean_X(df_syn[FEATURES].values)
    y = df_syn["depth"].values

    skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=SEED)
    fold_accs = []
    for train_idx, test_idx in skf.split(X, y):
        rf = RandomForestClassifier(**RF_PARAMS)
        rf.fit(X[train_idx], y[train_idx])
        fold_accs.append(accuracy_score(y[test_idx], rf.predict(X[test_idx])))

    rf_full = RandomForestClassifier(**RF_PARAMS)
    rf_full.fit(X, y)
    report = classification_report(y, rf_full.predict(X), output_dict=True)

    return {
        "cell": cell_name,
        "d1d3_cv_acc_mean": float(np.mean(fold_accs)),
        "d1d3_cv_acc_std": float(np.std(fold_accs)),
        "d1d3_n_samples": len(df_syn),
        "chance_3class": 1/3,
        "per_class_recall_train_set": {
            str(k): round(v["recall"], 4) for k, v in report.items() if k in ["1", "2", "3"]
        },
        "note": "per_class_recall is train-set memorization (rf_full.predict on training data)",
    }


# -- Sub-exp B: Seed-stratified LOGO on d1-d3 --

def subexp_b(df, cell_name):
    df_syn = df[df["depth"].isin([1, 2, 3])].reset_index(drop=True)
    X = clean_X(df_syn[FEATURES].values)
    y = df_syn["depth"].values
    seed_ids = df_syn["seed_id"].values

    groups, n_seeds = assign_groups(seed_ids)

    # Verify groups are depth-balanced
    for g in range(N_SEED_GROUPS):
        g_mask = groups == g
        g_depths = y[g_mask]
        counts = {d: int((g_depths == d).sum()) for d in [1, 2, 3]}
        assert all(abs(c - counts[1]) <= 1 for c in counts.values()), (
            f"Group {g} not balanced: {counts}"
        )

    fold_accs = []
    fold_details = []
    for g in range(N_SEED_GROUPS):
        test_mask = groups == g
        train_mask = ~test_mask
        if test_mask.sum() == 0 or train_mask.sum() == 0:
            continue

        # Verify no seed article overlap between train and test
        train_seeds = set(seed_ids[train_mask])
        test_seeds = set(seed_ids[test_mask])
        assert len(train_seeds & test_seeds) == 0, "Seed article leak detected"

        rf = RandomForestClassifier(**RF_PARAMS)
        rf.fit(X[train_mask], y[train_mask])
        acc = accuracy_score(y[test_mask], rf.predict(X[test_mask]))
        fold_accs.append(acc)
        fold_details.append({
            "fold": g,
            "acc": round(acc, 6),
            "n_test": int(test_mask.sum()),
            "n_test_seeds": len(test_seeds),
        })

    # Also compute standard 5-fold CV for comparison
    skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=SEED)
    std_cv_accs = []
    for train_idx, test_idx in skf.split(X, y):
        rf = RandomForestClassifier(**RF_PARAMS)
        rf.fit(X[train_idx], y[train_idx])
        std_cv_accs.append(accuracy_score(y[test_idx], rf.predict(X[test_idx])))

    logo_mean = float(np.mean(fold_accs))
    std_cv_mean = float(np.mean(std_cv_accs))

    return {
        "cell": cell_name,
        "logo_acc_mean": logo_mean,
        "logo_acc_std": float(np.std(fold_accs)),
        "logo_acc_min": float(np.min(fold_accs)),
        "logo_acc_max": float(np.max(fold_accs)),
        "std_cv_acc_mean": std_cv_mean,
        "std_cv_acc_std": float(np.std(std_cv_accs)),
        "drop_pp": round((std_cv_mean - logo_mean) * 100, 2),
        "n_folds": len(fold_accs),
        "n_seeds": n_seeds,
        "fold_details": fold_details,
    }


# -- Sub-exp C: Negative control — seed group vs depth prediction --

def subexp_c(df, cell_name):
    df_syn = df[df["depth"].isin([1, 2, 3])].reset_index(drop=True)
    X = clean_X(df_syn[FEATURES].values)
    y_depth = df_syn["depth"].values
    seed_ids = df_syn["seed_id"].values

    groups, _ = assign_groups(seed_ids)

    skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=SEED)

    depth_accs = cross_val_score(
        RandomForestClassifier(**RF_PARAMS), X, y_depth, cv=skf, scoring="accuracy"
    )
    group_accs = cross_val_score(
        RandomForestClassifier(**RF_PARAMS), X, groups, cv=skf, scoring="accuracy"
    )

    per_depth_group_accs = {}
    for d in [1, 2, 3]:
        mask = y_depth == d
        X_d, g_d = X[mask], groups[mask]
        if len(np.unique(g_d)) < 2:
            continue
        skf_d = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=SEED)
        try:
            accs = cross_val_score(
                RandomForestClassifier(**RF_PARAMS), X_d, g_d, cv=skf_d, scoring="accuracy"
            )
            per_depth_group_accs[str(d)] = float(np.mean(accs))
        except ValueError:
            per_depth_group_accs[str(d)] = None

    return {
        "cell": cell_name,
        "depth_pred_acc": float(np.mean(depth_accs)),
        "depth_pred_std": float(np.std(depth_accs)),
        "seed_group_pred_acc": float(np.mean(group_accs)),
        "seed_group_pred_std": float(np.std(group_accs)),
        "chance_seed_group": 1.0 / N_SEED_GROUPS,
        "per_depth_seed_group_pred": per_depth_group_accs,
    }


def main(sub_experiments=None):
    if sub_experiments is None:
        sub_experiments = ["A", "B", "C"]
    results = {"subexp_a": [], "subexp_b": [], "subexp_c": []}
    results["meta"] = {
        "version": "v2",
        "fix": "uses actual seed_id from raw depth_*.jsonl instead of sequential ordering assumption",
        "n_seed_groups": N_SEED_GROUPS,
        "rf_params": RF_PARAMS,
    }
    t0 = time.time()

    for cell_name, cell_cfg in CELLS.items():
        feat_path = ROOT / cell_cfg["features"]

        if not feat_path.exists():
            print(f"SKIP {cell_name}: {feat_path} not found")
            continue
        print(f"\n{'='*60}")
        print(f"Processing {cell_name}")
        print(f"{'='*60}")

        df = load_features_with_seed_id(cell_cfg["features"], raw_dir)
        print(f"  Loaded {len(df)} rows, depths: {sorted(df['depth'].unique())}")
        print(f"  seed_id range: [{df['seed_id'].min()}, {df['seed_id'].max()}]")

        if "A" in sub_experiments:
            print("  [A] d1-d3 3-class classification...")
            res_a = subexp_a(df, cell_name)
            results["subexp_a"].append(res_a)
            print(f"      CV acc={res_a['d1d3_cv_acc_mean']:.4f} +/- {res_a['d1d3_cv_acc_std']:.4f}")

        if "B" in sub_experiments:
            print("  [B] Seed-stratified LOGO (actual seed_id)...")
            res_b = subexp_b(df, cell_name)
            results["subexp_b"].append(res_b)
            print(f"      LOGO acc={res_b['logo_acc_mean']:.4f} +/- {res_b['logo_acc_std']:.4f}")
            print(f"      Std CV ={res_b['std_cv_acc_mean']:.4f}, drop={res_b['drop_pp']:.2f}pp")
            print(f"      Range [{res_b['logo_acc_min']:.4f}, {res_b['logo_acc_max']:.4f}]")

        if "C" in sub_experiments:
            print("  [C] Negative control (seed group vs depth)...")
            res_c = subexp_c(df, cell_name)
            results["subexp_c"].append(res_c)
            print(f"      depth_pred={res_c['depth_pred_acc']:.4f}, seed_group_pred={res_c['seed_group_pred_acc']:.4f} (chance={res_c['chance_seed_group']:.2f})")

    elapsed = time.time() - t0
    results["elapsed_seconds"] = elapsed

    # Summary
    print(f"\n{'='*60}")
    print("SUMMARY")
    print(f"{'='*60}")

    if "A" in sub_experiments and results["subexp_a"]:
        print("\n[A] d1-d3 3-class CV accuracy (chance=33.3%):")
        for r in results["subexp_a"]:
            print(f"  {r['cell']:25s}  {r['d1d3_cv_acc_mean']*100:5.1f}% +/- {r['d1d3_cv_acc_std']*100:4.1f}%")
        a_accs = [r["d1d3_cv_acc_mean"] for r in results["subexp_a"]]
        print(f"  {'MEAN':25s}  {np.mean(a_accs)*100:5.1f}%")

    if "B" in sub_experiments and results["subexp_b"]:
        print("\n[B] Seed-stratified LOGO accuracy (d1-d3, actual seed_id):")
        print(f"  {'Cell':25s}  {'LOGO':>8s}  {'StdCV':>8s}  {'Drop':>8s}  {'Min':>8s}  {'Max':>8s}")
        for r in results["subexp_b"]:
            print(f"  {r['cell']:25s}  {r['logo_acc_mean']*100:7.1f}%  {r['std_cv_acc_mean']*100:7.1f}%  {r['drop_pp']:+7.2f}pp  {r['logo_acc_min']*100:7.1f}%  {r['logo_acc_max']*100:7.1f}%")
        b_logo = [r["logo_acc_mean"] for r in results["subexp_b"]]
        b_cv = [r["std_cv_acc_mean"] for r in results["subexp_b"]]
        b_drop = [r["drop_pp"] for r in results["subexp_b"]]
        b_mins = [r["logo_acc_min"] for r in results["subexp_b"]]
        print(f"  {'MEAN':25s}  {np.mean(b_logo)*100:7.1f}%  {np.mean(b_cv)*100:7.1f}%  {np.mean(b_drop):+7.2f}pp  {np.min(b_mins)*100:7.1f}%")

    if "C" in sub_experiments and results["subexp_c"]:
        print("\n[C] Negative control -- depth vs seed group prediction:")
        print(f"  {'Cell':25s}  {'Depth':>8s}  {'SeedGrp':>8s}  {'Chance':>8s}  {'Ratio':>8s}")
        for r in results["subexp_c"]:
            ratio = r["depth_pred_acc"] / max(r["seed_group_pred_acc"], 0.01)

    print(f"\nTotal elapsed: {elapsed:.1f}s")

    out_path = OUT_DIR / "w2_domain_bias_v2_results.json"
    with open(out_path, "w") as f:
        json.dump(results, f, indent=2)
    print(f"\nResults saved to {out_path}")
